response.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute - a.all_operator_avg) AS avg_margin_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE o.avg_gb_per_minute > a.all_operator_avg;

assumptions.assumption: A scan with zero duration has an undefined GB-per-minute rate and is excluded from rate averages.
